text.text: Plan the week from your recipe library, then shop by aisle. Add a recipe, drop it in a slot, and the shopping list follows.
One focused hour on a quiet day saves a week of decisions. Use the list below, then mark the meals cooked as you go.
An hour of prep makes weekday dinners painless.
Check what is already in the fridge
Wash and chop vegetables for two dinners

cells.text: Cook grains and portion breakfast jars

text.text: Keep these on hand so the plan never stalls.
Olive oil, vinegar and soy sauce
Restock when a staple drops to its last unit.
Check the pantry shelf before writing the shopping list, not after.
Buy a second one the day you open the last one of anything you use weekly.
Keep a short list of five meals that need only pantry items for the nights the plan falls apart.
